# Teaching & supervision

I teach in linguistics, psycholinguistics and cognitive science, with particular emphasis on questions about meaning, language comprehension and experimental reasoning.
</div>

<section class="section">
<div class="section-copy">

## Teaching interests

My teaching centres on the relationship between linguistic structure and cognition. Topics that recur across teaching and supervision include semantics, sentence processing, psycholinguistics, experimental methods, inference, prediction, memory and discourse.

For prospective graduate students, the <a href="people.html">People</a> page gives the best overview of the kinds of projects that fit my research.
</div>
</section>

## Current materials

Course-specific readings, problem sets and other teaching materials can be added here as needed. The site is intentionally designed so that this section can remain short and low-maintenance rather than becoming a second learning platform.
